prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star mobile website comp, portrait phone invitation, option 1
Primary request: design the first two viewports of a premium digital quinceañera invitation for Karen Paola Hernández Ávila, no navigation and no people; vertical editorial sequence beginning with an interactive couture-curtain cover and continuing into the event date
Surface structure in order: full-screen opening cover with subtle silk-curtain folds and asymmetrical floral crystal ornament; small MIS XV; dominant readable name Karen Paola and smaller Hernández Ávila; date SÁBADO 10 DE OCTUBRE; refined opening control ABRIR INVITACIÓN; below the fold a quiet blessing and parents/godparents introduction
Style/medium: realistic shippable luxury mobile web UI, not a poster and not concept art
Composition/framing: 390x844-style portrait screen shown straight-on, edge-to-edge UI; generous vertical breathing room; show enough below first fold to prove scrolling narrative
Lighting/mood: evening gala, soft reflected light, sophisticated feminine contemporary luxury
Color palette: predominant #05222C and #043F52, accents #097087 #61A3AA, pearled silver #CBD6D4, tiny dusty rose #AC7E75
Materials/textures: subtle petroleum-blue silk folds, fine silver seams, small crystals, handcrafted fabric flowers
Typography: high-contrast luxury serif for the name and titles, clean restrained sans serif for information, readable Spanish text
Constraints: no photos of people, no gallery, no logos, no watermark, no neon, no glass cards, no generic wedding look, no excessive ornament, no illegible script, no invented event facts
Avoid: childish motifs, gold, white bridal palette, excessive sparkles, generic template cards, AI artifacts
